info.name: NC WireGuard
info.summary: Control and monitor an external WireGuard engine from Nextcloud
info.description:
NC WireGuard is a Nextcloud admin UI for an **external** WireGuard engine. It does **not** ship or run a VPN dataplane itself.
Today the supported engine is [wg-easy](https://github.com/wg-easy/wg-easy) (configure its API URL and credentials in Administration settings). An optional thin wg-sync sidecar is a lab/migration path only.
Features: create/edit/enable/disable peers, Field/Admin presets, one-time config links, bandwidth and connection history, optional GeoIP map, and host metrics polling into Nextcloud tables.
**Privacy:** GeoIP is off by default. When enabled, peer public endpoint IPs may be sent to the configured GeoIP provider. Engine credentials are stored in Nextcloud appconfig (password confirmation required to save).
Not affiliated with or endorsed by WireGuard or wg-easy. WireGuard is a registered trademark of Jason A. Donenfeld.
Admin-only access. Requires a reachable engine before the dashboard is useful — see INSTALL.md.
